content.snl: def-hyp(list-partial(Type.annotation(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.annotation(list-partial(@x, @L), Real)), list-partial(Analysis.limLeft(F, @y, x, L), Analysis.limRight(F, @y, x, L)), Logic.and(Logic.exists-typed(@delta, Real, Logic.and($#0 > 0$(delta), Set.subset(Ioo(Sub.sub(x, delta), x), Analysis.domain(F)))), Logic.forall-typed(@epsilon, Real, Logic.implies($#0 > 0$(epsilon), Logic.exists-typed(@delta, Real, Logic.and($#0 > 0$(delta), Logic.forall-typed(@y, Real, Logic.implies(Set.mem(y, Ioo(Sub.sub(x, delta), x)), Set.mem(Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), y), Analysis.nbh(L, epsilon))))))))))

values.en:
The left limit replaces the punctured neighbourhood by the left half-interval `(x₀ − delta, x₀)`; the right limit uses `(x₀, x₀ + delta)`. Both keep the two-clause shape of `BasicAnalysis.def.funLimit`, including the well-posedness requirement that the relevant half-interval lie inside the domain.

A function has a limit at `x₀` iff both one-sided limits exist and agree, which is the standard route to detecting a jump discontinuity.
values.zh-CN:
左极限将去心邻域替换为左半区间 `(x₀ − delta, x₀)`；右极限使用 `(x₀, x₀ + delta)`。二者都保留 `BasicAnalysis.def.funLimit` 的双条件结构，包括要求相应半区间包含于定义域的适定性条件。

函数在 `x₀` 处有极限，当且仅当两个单侧极限都存在且相等；这是识别跳跃间断点的标准方法。
